43: Wounded Civil War soldier John Dunbar tries to commit suicide—and becomes a hero instead. As a reward, he's assigned to his dream post, a remote junction on the Western frontier, and soon makes unlikely friends with the local Sioux tribe.
Inside everyone is a frontier waiting to be discovered.
299: As a young and naive recruit in Vietnam, Chris Taylor faces a moral crisis when confronted with the horrors of war and the duality of man.
The first casualty of war is innocence.
555: The Guardians must fight to keep their newfound family together as they unravel the mysteries of Peter Quill's true parentage.
Anyone can save the galaxy once.
811: When Lenny and his wife, Amanda, adopt a baby, Lenny realizes that his son is a genius and becomes obsessed with finding the boy's biological mother in hopes that she will be brilliant too. Of all human weaknesses, obsession is the most dangerous, and the silliest!
1067: In April of 1945, Germany stands at the brink of defeat with the Russian Army closing in from the east and the Allied Expeditionary Force attacking from the west. April 1945, a nation awaits its... Downfall

1579: Blending lively music and brilliant animation, this sequel to the original 'Fantasia' restores 'The Sorcerer's Apprentice' and adds seven new shorts.
1835: It's 1961, two years after the original Grease gang graduated, and there's a new crop of seniors and new members of the coolest cliques on campus, the Pink Ladies and T-Birds. Can he fix up an old motorcycle, don a leather jacket, avoid a rumble with the leader of the T-Birds, and win the heart of Pink Lady Stephanie?
The Music and Feeling go on Forever.
2091: After being shot in a toy store, a serial killer transfers his soul into a Good Guy doll. A mother then gifts it to her six-year-old son Andy, which unleashes terror upon the city.
You'll wish it was only make-believe.
2347: A motorcycle stunt rider considers committing a crime in order to provide for his wife and child, an act that puts him on a collision course with a cop-turned-politician.
One moment can change your life.
2603: Demoted Pittsburgh cop Tom Hardy works river patrol while a serial killer targets women from his past, forcing him to conduct an unauthorized investigation to prove his innocence and expose a dirty cop.
They shouldn't have put him in the water, if they didn't want him to make waves.
2859: An aspiring actor in Hollywood meets an enigmatic stranger by the name of Tommy Wiseau, the meeting leads the actor down a path nobody could have predicted; creating the worst movie ever made.
Based on the true story of one movie so bad it became infamous.

They destroyed everything he had, everything he was. Now, crime has a new enemy and justice has a new face.
3371: In a small English village everyone suddenly falls unconscious. When they awake every woman of child bearing age is pregnant. The resulting children have the same strange blond hair, eyes and a strong connection to each other.
What Demonic Force Lurks Behind Those Eyes?

The battle for eternity is the fantasy of a lifetime.
The Silent Monk / The Monkey King
3883: A married woman realizes how unhappy her marriage really is, and that her life needs to go in a different direction. After a painful divorce, she takes off on a round-the-world journey to "find herself".
4139: Two parents deal with the effects when their son is accused of murdering his girlfriend.
A murder. A suspect. A shadow of a doubt.
4395: Two brothers return to the cult they fled from years ago to discover that the group's beliefs may be more sane than they once thought.
4651: A judge gives con-man Tom Turner a choice—a jail sentence, or a year of honest work. Many people write to God. Somebody is answering.
4907: A blind man has an operation to regain his sight at the urging of his girlfriend and must deal with the changes to his life.
Science gave him sight. She gave him vision.

As Jack struggles to get used to his new surroundings, Ed helps him regain his confidence on and off the field.

A story about two guys trying to make it in the big city.
5675: Reunited after 15 years, famous chef Sasha and hometown musician Marcus feel the old sparks of attraction, but struggle to adapt to each other's worlds.
There's Always Been Something Between Them.
5931: A 59-year-old carpenter recovering from a heart attack befriends a single mother and her two kids as they navigate the impersonal, Kafkaesque benefits system. With equal amounts of humour, warmth and despair, the journey is heartfelt and emotional until the end.
My name is Daniel Blake. I am a man, not a dog.
6187: Wang Bianlian is an aging street performer known as the King of Mask for his mastery of Sichuan Change Art in a true story. His wife left him with and infant son over 30 years ago. The son died from illness at age 10. This left Wang a melancholy loner aching for a male descendent to learn his rare and dying art.
6443: A skilled young hockey prospect hoping to attract the attention of professional scouts is pressured to show that he can fight if challenged during his stay in a Canadian minor hockey town. His on-ice activities are complicated by his relationship with the coach's daughter.
The ice... The fire... The fight... To be the best.
6699: After his mother’s death, Zucchini is befriended by a kind police officer, Raymond, who accompanies him to his new foster home filled with other orphans his age. SOMETIMES WE CRY BECAUSE WE'RE HAPPY.
6955: The film centres on Moncho and his coming-of-age experience in Galicia in 1936. Moncho develops a close relationship with his teacher Don Gregorio who introduces the boy to different things in the world. 7211: Rick Rambis and his friends are having the time of their lives on Bull Mountain—until the legendary Papa Muntz' son decides to sell the mountain to a sleazy land developer, have the staff fired and turn Bull Mountain into 'Yuppieville'.
They haven't quite figured it all out, but they're getting a little warmer.
7723: A virtually plotless, gaudy, impressionistic portrait of Rome through the eyes of one of its most famous citizens.
The fall of the Roman Empire 1931-1972.
7979: The Tall Man, that imposing menace from Morningside Mortuary, is back and once again haunting the thoughts of the now-adult Mike and his friend, ex-Ice Cream vendor Reggie. If You Don't Get It This Time, He'll Have To Drill It Into Your Head!
8235: In order to boost circulation of his newspaper, Lord Rawnsley announces an air race and offers £10,000 to the first person who can fly across the English Channel. But one of the participants, Percy, plots to sabotage his competitor's planes. Will Percy triumph?
20th Century-Fox Presents The Motion Picture That Sets Comedy Ahead 100 Years!
8491: Professor James Murray begins work compiling words for the first edition of the Oxford English Dictionary in the mid 19th century, and receives over 10,000 entries from a patient at Broadmoor Criminal Lunatic Asylum, Dr. William Minor.
The incredible true story that defined our world.
9003: An unsuccessful over-the-top actress becomes a successful over-the-top authoress in this biography of Jacqueline Susann.
9259: A detective tries to remain loyal to his partner, and his best friend - a mobster.
9515: A couple of young, out-of-work archaeologists in Egypt discover evidence of the burial place of the ancient Egyptian princess Ananka. The tomb of a thousand terrors!
9771: A group of tormented patients stage a coup at an oppressive, dismal asylum after they're not allowed out on an excursion.
10027: On the set of a playwright's new project, a love triangle forms between his wife, her ex-lover, and the call girl-turned-actress cast in the production.
Show biz has always been a little screwball.

The Devil's work is never done.

Still innocently believing love can conquer any difficulty, Lili sets out to save her dog. Failing in his desperate efforts to find his beloved owner, Hagen joins a canine revolt leading a revolution against their human abusers.
The unwanted will have their day.
11051: In 1970s London, a teenage outsider named Enn falls in love with a rebellious alien girl named Zan, who has come to Earth for a party. Together, they navigate the complexities of intergalactic culture and the trials of first love.
Some girls are out of this world.

No one knows what the future holds. That’s why its potential is infinite.
11563: Paul and Kim meet when their vehicles collide. Paul is fascinated with the attractive Kim. It turns out that the two were childhood friends in Catholic boys' school, but back then, before the operation, Kim was named Karl.
11819: A group of bad cops look to dispose of a body that one of them accidentally shot.
12075: A squad of unsuspecting cops go through a trapdoor to Hell when they stumble upon a Black Mass in an abandoned building.
Enter a world of suffering and madness.
12331: Two former cops start investigating the series of murders that tanked their careers when the killings begin again.
12843: Basque Country, Spain, 1843. A police constable arrives at a small village in Álava to investigate a mysterious blacksmith who lives alone deep in the woods.
13355: The titular adventurer, after defying his parents to go to sea, survives a shipwreck and becomes a castaway on a deserted island for nearly thirty years, learning to build a new life from scratch, discovering companionship with a native man he names Friday, and eventually returning to civilisation a changed man, finding wealth and new challenges.
Every thrill-swept page blazes to life on the screen!

When the Creeping Dead Devour the Living Flesh!
13867: Psychotherapist Ruben Brandt becomes the most wanted criminal in the world when he and four of his patients steal paintings from the world's most renowned museums and art collections.
Membrano Bruno (voice) / Van Gogh's Postman (voice) / Renoir (voice)
14123: A wanna-be concert pianist spends his days making a living by collecting debts for his Mafioso father, a lifestyle that could eventually ruin his dreams of a musical career.
Some will love it. Others will be angered by it. Everyone will be stunned by it!
14379: The ageing wrestler Sultan Ali Khan decides to try his luck on the mat again; to do this, he wants to represent his country at the Olympic Games, but first has to overcome personal issues.
Wrestling is not a sport. Its about fighting what lies within.
14635: A prep-school student accidentally films the drug-related deaths of two classmates, then is asked to put together a memorial video.

15147: The rise of Aretha Franklin’s career from a child singing in her father’s church’s choir to her international superstardom.
15659: A burned-out British police detective finally snaps while interrogating a suspected child molester.
After 20 years, what detective-sergeant Johnson has seen and done is destroying him.

Through conversations with the locals, he soon unearths the Whateleys' darkest secret — as well as a great evil.
A few years ago in Dunwich a half-witted girl bore illegitimate twins. One of them was almost human!
16171: New York's Odyssey Detective Agency is hired by two different clients to follow two women suspected of infidelity. Ladies' man John Russo trails Angela Niotes, the elegant wife of a wealthy Italian industrialist, while Charles Rutledge and Arthur Brodsky follow Dolores Martin, the beautiful young wife of a jealous husband. Their respective cases are complicated when John falls for Angela, and Charles falls for Dolores.
Some of them promised they'd never fall in love.
16683: Two San Francisco detectives want to bring down a local hijacking boss. But they'll have to get to him before a hitman does.
Above all... It's a love story.
16939: In this comedy of an Englishman stranded in a sea of barbaric Americans, Marmaduke Ruggles – a gentleman's gentleman and butler to an Earl – is lost in a poker game to an uncouth American cattle baron. SH-H-H-H! TONIGHT'S YOUR NIGHT TO HOWL! And howl you will at this funniest of all comedies...
17195: Embarking on a journey to fulfill her dreams as a dancer, a young girl discovers a new style of dance that will prove to be the source of both conflict and self-discovery.
Hear The Music. Feel The Beat.

A drama fired with Hepburn's blazing genius!
17963: When a good-natured factory supervisor living in Milan with his Northern wife returns to his native Sicily, a decades' old oath forces him to fulfill a nightmarish obligation.

This is the face of a MAFIOSO...sometimes smiling, sometimes savage. Here is the story of a man who returns to his native Sicily for a holiday and finds himself again bound to the silent laws of "The Honored Society."

Enter Robin Hood, acrobatic champion of the oppressed, laboring to set things right through swashbuckling feats and cliffhanging perils!
18475: A famous surgeon is beaten by drunken bullies, loses his memory and cannot recollect who he was before. He gets to a village, lives in a not so well to do family and becomes the Quack - he slowly regains his talent for medicine and saves the lives of several village patients.
18987: Chaos and rampant hormones reign when teenage counselors are left in charge during their summer-camp director's absence.
19499: The Inguri River forms a natural border dividing Georgia from Abkhazia. One of the spring floods has created a little island in the middle of the river, as if made for the cultivation of corn. At least, this is the belief of an old peasant, whose sunburned face resembles the landscape he has trodden for dozens of years.

Demetris tries to change her mind, but Lonesome insists. It’s at this moment that he comes to a decision. This decision will change his entire life. If Demetris goes out, he will meet Christina, the love of his life. If he stays in, he will not meet her. Does true love exist? A love story in a changing world
20523: In this tale of small town intrigue, an urbanite returns to his quiet hometown on an impromptu trip as his Uncle, widely respected in town, struggles to evade suspicion of a murder.
20779: A family intervention goes horrifically awry within the snowy confines of an isolated lake house.
21035: Otherworldly creatures inhabit the bootlegging tunnels underneath a small town mining community, and they kill any of the townsfolk who invade their home.
21291: When a young stage hopeful is found dead, suspicion falls on her mentor, a successful Broadway producer.
Someone will kill this girl tonight!
21803: David Portnoy, a 15-year-old birding fanatic, thinks that he's made the discovery of a lifetime. So, on the eve of his father's remarriage, he escapes on an epic road trip with his best friends to solidify their place in birding history.

Explore the outer limits of imagination where humans battle a race of giant bionoids.
22315: Charles is a bored civil servant struggling through a harsh Utah winter. He spends most of his time reflecting on his romance with Laura, a coworker who left him to return to her husband, an A-Frame salesman.
A romantic comedy for all seasons
22571: A man, crippled in an accident, returns to the woods after rehabilitation, certain that he'll not see Bigfoot again.
23083: Summer 1939. Influential families in Nazi Germany have sent their daughters to a finishing school in an English seaside town to learn the language and be ambassadors for a future looking National Socialist. A teacher there sees what is coming and is trying to raise the alarm. But the authorities believe he is the problem.
Britain 1939. Hitler's grip is tightening. No-one can be trusted.
23339: An artist and her elderly mother confront long-buried secrets when they return to a former family home, now a hotel haunted by its mysterious past.
23595: Inspired from the true incidents occurred in Bengaluru - 1983, Kaiva brings the visual grandeur of Old Bengaluru showing the lights of world famous Bengaluru Karaga and the dark underworld of the city as well.
23851: A carefree vacation turns into a desperate race against time when a group of lifelong friends must unite to save one of their own from a notoriously perilous, uncharted abyss deep within the Guna Caves.
24107: Follows interconnected stories of several different couples, each facing a crossroads at different stages in their lives and relationships.

A triumphant story of a fighter who reclaims her power, in and out of the ring, when everyone has counted her out
It's not a second chance. It's a last chance.

On the other hand, he is deeply in love with Pari, whose father has kept the conditions to marry her. To make ends meet, Karam dons as Pooja, which creates wild chaos and a comedy of errors.
24875: When three young women are harassed and implicated in a crime they didn't commit, a bipolar lawyer sets out to help them clear their names and prove it to everyone that a woman's consent matters.
25131: Kaagaz (transl. Paper) is a biographical drama about a farmer, Lal Bihari's 19-year struggle to make himself come alive again when he is declared dead in Government records by interests keen to take over his assets.
A True Success Story of a Dead Man
25387: Life is tough for Geyikli clarinetist Huseyin Badem after marrying his true love, Mujgan. He must grab every opportunity that comes his way to take care of his expanding family, even if it means playing clarinet by night for dingy clubs in the area.
25643: A boy runs away from home, angry with his stepfather and half-brother. Years later, he becomes a police inspector and fights a notorious criminal.
25899: After crash-landing on an alien planet, an asteroid miner must contend with the challenges of his new surroundings, while making his way across the harsh terrain to the only other survivor – a woman who is trapped in her escape pod.
26155: ‘Awe’ charts the journey of a motley of characters that have nothing to do with each other but are yet connected by a single, fragile string. Who are these people and what about their lives connect them to each other is what the film is all about.
26411: Four teenagers decide to spend their summer holiday on a camping at the beach. Officially to disseminate ashes of a grandfather, but foremost to finally get laid.
26667: The Chinese government launches a daring operation to arrest a violent drug cartel following the discovery of thirteen Chinese crew members' bodies on two ships sailing through the Mekong River.
26923: Wendy Darling strikes out in an attempt to rescue her brother Michael from the clutches of the evil Peter Pan who intends to send him to Neverland. Along the way she meets a twisted Tinkerbell, who is hooked on what she thinks is fairy dust.
27179: A bandit leader kidnaps the wife of the policeman who killed his sister, but later falls in love with her.
Not just a story, a world.
27435: Alex and Selma are a couple in love on a trip to the heart of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Suddenly, Selma feels a mysterious force is chasing them.
27691: Arif, who is trying to write his first book, believes that life contains many unanswerable questions, especially about women and relationships. But when Müzeyyen appears unexpectedly, everything he has ever known or tried to learn is suddenly turned upside down.

Dying he shows Rizzo a picture of his young son Bodo. Rizzo travels to Johannesburg to find out what the policeman was working on and to find Bodo.
28459: Fully authorized, access-all-areas feature doc on the hugely charismatic and globally adored Usain Bolt – officially the fastest man alive. I AM BOLT will reveal the man and define the legacy of this incredible athlete.
28715: The Viking children Røskva and Tjalfe embark on an adventurous journey from Midgard to Valhalla with the gods Thor and Loki. Life in Valhalla, however, turns out to be threatened by the dreaded Fenrir wolf and the god's barbaric archenemies, the Jotnar. Side by side with the gods the two children must fight to save Valhalla from the end of the world - Ragnarok.

The incredible true story of Italy's most notorious gangster.

Thank God it's only a motion picture!
29995: After the forcible transfer to his Bavarian home village, an ex-criminal cop investigates the death of a school principal who he thinks had lots to hide.

The action-thriller movie is based on true events
30507: Gentle and broken, a homeless man fights others on video for money but soon finds comfort in an unlikely friend and the lost diary of a young girl.
30763: A zoo veterinarian gets caught up in a grisly adventure as she finds herself leading the city-wide hunt for a monstrous lion terrorizing the Dutch capital of Amsterdam.
On the loose... and he's hungry.

Love is the brightest light of all
31531: Blake Redding is trapped in this dark room wanting to protect his love so the only thing he will do is escape like no failed student has done before.

An All New Height in Fright and Might!
32043: A hugely successful DA goes into private practice after sending a man to the chair -- only to find out later he was innocent. Now the drunken attorney only seems to represent criminals and low lifes.
He was a guy who marked 100 men for death - until a blonde called 'Angel' O'Hara marked him for life!
32555: Spike Lee pays tribute to Michael Jackson's Bad on the twenty-fifth anniversary of the epochal album, offering behind-the-scenes footage of Jackson recording the album and interviews with confidants, musicians, choreographers, and such music-world superstars as Kanye West, Sheryl Crow, Cee Lo Green and Mariah Carey.

He's a scoundrel... A hero... A lover of danger and the last of the adventurers... This is the story of Bully Hayes!
33067: Zandra, white princess of a lost civilization, comes to Tarzan for help when Nazis invade the jungle with plans to conquer her people and take their wealth. Tarzan, the isolationist, becomes involved after the Nazis shoot at him and capture Boy: "Now Tarzan make war!"
A new beautiful beauty arouses Tarzan's fighting heart!
33323: Upon the reopening of the opera house where her mother was murdered, a teen and her friends become the targets of a deranged killer dressed in a clown costume.
So Many Victims, So Little Time
33579: A holiday fable that tells the story of an elderly man discovering love for the first time.
Something mysterious, new, unexpected and lovely is happening to Robert Malone.
33835: A story about the life of a young girl living with her mother in the slums of Manila, which becomes unbearable when her mother's young boyfriend moves in with them.
34091: Tangled in a troubled marriage, a frustrated couple finds hope in a watch-based app that rewards good deeds — until unhealthy obsessiveness takes over.
34347: Once upon a time, somewhere... a homeless guy finds a policeman's uniform...
34603: Cosmin plays a tennis game with 3 friends. He looks at the clock and starts panicking: he is late to the Registry Office, to a wedding- his wedding, with his ex-wife, who he had divorced without his friends knowing. THE STORY OF PROWL CAR 13...BASED ON THE POLICE FILES OF A GREAT CITY!

Le sergent / Le vieux à la canne (voice)

GABLE'S back and GARSON'S got him!

One of the Commandments of the Mother of the Sea

In 1518 A.D. only the noblest warriors survive
